how: We read the website of every Detroit wedding DJ listed on Lazo (76 listings, 58 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a site whose text came through as garbage, an Indiana DJ company behind an Ann Arbor listing, a Lansing-area DJ, corporate AV companies, and Windsor-side DJs. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will be at my wedding, and can I talk to that DJ before I sign?
How do you handle the ceremony audio and the toasts, not just the dance floor?
What is in the base price, and what are uplighting, photo booth and extra hours on top, especially for a Friday or a winter date?

picks.name: SKY ENTERTAINMENT LLC
picks.blurb: Gagan founded Sky Entertainment, a Canton company that handles DJ, photography, videography and lighting for Indian and Pakistani weddings across Michigan, Ohio and Indiana. The site lists the South Asian events it covers and claims 15-plus years of experience.

picks.name: Pro DJ Services
picks.blurb: Pro DJ Services builds its reputation around one promise, that the dance floor will be packed, and says the team starts building the night the minute you leave its St Clair Shores office. DJs, photographers, videographers and photo booths, in business since 2010.

picks.name: DJ Crashers
picks.blurb: DJ Crashers prints its DJ prices and photo booth rental prices on the site, with DJ-and-booth wedding specials and an Ultimate Wedding Package. Uplighting and wedding photography round it out, along with song lists and a wedding DJ questionnaire. Lake Orion.

picks.name: CC King Entertainment
picks.blurb: Tony Coppola started out chasing a career as a drummer in the Metro Detroit music scene in 2008 before founding CC King Entertainment in Livonia. Wedding DJs plus photo booths with prints, Chiavari chairs and pipe and drape, with wedding playlists and planning guides on the site.

picks.name: Showtime DJs
picks.blurb: DJ Show has performed at over 300 events including nearly 100 weddings, mixing beat-matched sets with MC work. A package for weddings under 100 guests, with a two-speaker system, master of ceremony and five hours of play time, is described as the budget-friendly option. Southfield.

picks.name: DJ Love - Sound & Lighting
picks.blurb: Love Gill, DJ Love, grew up just outside Detroit in a traditional South Asian home and built a versatile style through music production, going on to play prominent nightclubs and luxury weddings. Sound and lighting from Canton, with bookings open for 2025 and 2026.

picks.name: Stealth DJ's Mobile Disc Jockey Service - Michigan DJ & MC Entertainment
picks.blurb: Stealth DJ's sends a two-person DJ and MC team and can add motivational dancers to get the floor moving without stealing the spotlight. Pricing is laid out by event type and day of the week, with a ceremony audio and coordination offer for weddings. South Lyon, since 2000.

picks.name: Memory Maker Djs
picks.blurb: Memory Maker DJs runs regular DJ showcases so you can meet the DJs, listen and watch them work their own equipment before choosing. The site has DJ bios, ceremony and reception pages and a same-gender weddings page. New Baltimore.

picks.name: Three Mates Entertainment - Weddings & Events
picks.blurb: Longtime friends Matt and Tito founded Three Mates Entertainment in 2016, a DJ and event entertainment company built on music and bringing people together. Weddings, private parties and corporate events, with a repeat client on the site who booked them for a brother's wedding and then her own.

picks.name: JD Entertainment, LLC
picks.blurb: JD Entertainment has run since 1998, when John DeVergilio started it out of a love of music, and today its DJ department sits alongside photography and videography teams so you can bundle and save. Clinton Township.

picks.name: Lufru Entertainment
picks.blurb: Luke Frutig founded Lufru Entertainment in 2012 as a premium DJ service based in Ann Arbor, serving all of Southeast Michigan. Style, aesthetics and top-of-the-line equipment are the pitch, with what it calls a modern and refreshing take on mobile entertainment.

picks.name: CIV ENTERTAINMENT
picks.blurb: DJ CIV, born and raised in Pontiac, started in fifth-grade band and brings more than ten years of live mixing and crowd reading to weddings, with professional MC work and detailed planning behind each event. Auburn Hills.
